features: The download confirm sheet now shows the file size live for every quality and language you tap — tap 720p, Dub, or back to 1080p Sub and the size updates as you tap, with "checking…" while it fetches and instant answers for combos already checked
fixes: Fixed HLS size estimates using the peak bitrate — estimates now use AVERAGE-BANDWIDTH where the playlist lists it (calm 1080p was ~1.15 GB from peak BANDWIDTH vs ~540 MB from the average), so the "~" figure in the sheet is much closer to the real file

Fixed the sheet only showing a size when the pre-resolve had already cached that exact combo — tapping a different quality or language now warms a resolve for that combo in the background and fills the size in when it lands, without ever blocking the Download button

Fixed the size being borrowable across sources — the size now always comes from the actual link being downloaded for that exact quality/language/server (same episode, same 1080p, same sub: momo ~236 MB, calm ~540 MB, revo ~890 MB — 1080p is only the dimensions, every source encodes differently), so a size from one server is never shown for another; when a size genuinely cannot be determined the sheet shows nothing instead of a borrowed number
